story_sequence.text: Hook contracts live under `docs/beacon/hooks/<hook-id>.md`; version directories only hold research and requirement material.
Each hook is a single Markdown file with frontmatter and human-readable sections for purpose, admission, evidence, and failure route.
Hook admission validates lifecycle binding, enabled state, skill availability, command template, trigger policy, required evidence, and failure route; side-effect hooks require manual confirmation.
Hook runs write `.beacon/state/hooks/<hook-id>/<run-id>.json` and `docs/beacon/.machine/hooks/<hook-id>.latest.json` as evidence/read models only.
Operators can list, plan, dry-run, confirmed-run, disable, and inspect hook status without editing machine projections directly.
The contract covers Beacon post-release local install, Rolo post-implement UAT, and Rolo QA Debug Lab as fixtures, not global defaults.
Hooks cannot rewrite PRD, user-story, test-case, freeze state, QA verdict, release verdict, or gate verdict.
Hidden auto-run, arbitrary shell hooks, unknown hook codes, and missing failure routes fail closed with explicit reason codes.
